meta.title: Send a bulk counter offer to all vendors from Settings
warnings: resolved: “Verify the counter offer on every vendor's separate portal session; the catalog supports only one QA vendor portal sessi” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

plan.title: Send Bulk Counter Offer to All Vendors

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live auction with several vendor bids, as required by the setup.
Open the auction Settings menu and select the bulk counter-offer action.

args.goal: Decide the counter offer, send it to all vendors, and stop when the buyer screen shows that the bulk counter offer was sent successfully

steps.note: Complete the bulk counter-offer form and press Send, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Move to the available invited vendor's supplier portal to verify the recipient view.
Open the event overview where a pending counter offer is shown to the vendor.
Assert that the vendor portal displays the pending counter offer.
